# A range in the middle of a running event (08:00–09:00Z, range
# 08:30–08:45Z on 17.11.2026) matches; the weekly series that day at
# 10:00 Berlin (09:00Z) does not.
@seed calendar privat fruehstueck.ics running.ics
@seed calendar privat sport.ics weekly-tuesday.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>

< status 207
< responses 1
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/fruehstueck.ics d:getetag {etag:running.ics}
